name: oracle-dig
description: Provenance-first oracle_dig findings store with trace and local session evidence.

mcpTools.name: oracle_dig
mcpTools.description: Store a relationship finding with typed provenance evidence, optionally composing oracle_trace and oracle_sessions results.

subject.description: Finding subject; relationship triples start here.

dug_by.description: Federation tag for the oracle that produced the finding.

as_of_ts.description: Timestamp in milliseconds when this finding was known true.

evidence.description: Typed evidence rows: github, session, oracle-msg, or web.

trace.description: Optional oracle_trace CreateTraceInput to convert into GitHub evidence.

sessions.description: Optional oracle_sessions options, or false to skip session evidence.

mcpTools.name: oracle_sessions
mcpTools.description: Scan local Claude session JSONL files on this machine only; not a fleet-wide session search.
